description: Money and unit rules of the projection (flagship steps 3 and 5: landed cost and order margin abstain on unknown denominators and currencies) over live captures: offline and with no client, scripts.money_units_probe opens read-only the projection generation this session's ontology.session_projection committed over the live Portal mirror and BC capture, and reads its build report. Recorded: the money and unit gap codes (price_denominator_unknown, per_unit_unresolved, unit_unresolved, currency_invalid, currency_unresolved, conflict_across_records and the conflict_not_compared_* codes) in total and by source family (bc, portal_app, fm, sage, silver, gen, other; cross_record for conflicts); the values each per_unit_rules rule and each currency rule (sign_attached, sign_form; each fires only on a cell the base projection held currency_invalid: three letters in any case were already a code) decided per binding; why no denominator rule decided (unit_blank, units_disagree, no_rule_holds); the masked shapes of currency cells still invalid; without_rules (each gap plus the values rules decided on the same generation: a rule fires only on a value that was that gap) and the share decided. Pass = at least half of price_denominator_unknown and of currency_invalid decided, and no property conflict on a price whose denominator a rule decided or on an amount whose currency a rule read (ruled_price_conflicts and ruled_currency_conflicts 0: such a pair was never compared, or compared on an invalid code, before, so each would be a new conflict_across_records). The previous daily's ontology.session_projection gap codes are recorded beside them as context, never asserted (the data moves between days). Counts, booleans, rule ids, binding and source names and masked shapes only; never a value, key or identifier. Live-unverified until the live check records a result.
notes: Registered, live-unverified: no live-check result yet. Module test: isolated-fixture (ontology/tests/test_money_units.py builds the curated schema over hand-made Portal rows and runs this spec's summary over that build report through live_verify.check_expectations). Before (recorded: daily report of 2026-10-19, ontology.session_projection checked 2026-10-19T17:23Z): price_denominator_unknown 275,734; unit_unresolved 163,789; currency_invalid 77,711; conflict_across_records 62,545; conflict_not_compared_price_denominator 0. after and without_rules come from one generation, so the halving is measured on the same data; whether the FM currency cells are sign-attached codes (profiled code_like, 4-8 characters) is what the first run decides (currency_shapes name what is left). It requires ontology.session_projection, its session producer of {session_state}/projection (Portal and BC, service reader), reads it only (session_reads) and never runs cold (session_required): with no generation of this session it prints error session_projection_unavailable, a fail. The FM raw per-kg rule on app_supplier_product decides nothing while its source column stays null (100% null in the live profile), so the price halving rests on the Sage units_agree rule; C$ read as CAD is an assumption (ontology/units.py).
